dct_description_sm:
This layer gives access to all published data from the City of Fredericton IoT sensors. The features represent static locations for each of the sensors from different manufacturers. There are parking sensors (named Parking) and climate sensors (named Elsys, Decent Labs, and Sensus). Selecting a feature shows basic attributes of the sensor and there is also the ability to show related records to gain access to the historical sensor information.

Several views have been created off of this layer. IoT Sensors is a read only layer as the source is updated via a script in real-time. The 5 views are 1-M relationships for each sensor manufacturer and show the most recent information for each sensor. Each 1-M relationship has been run through the Join Features tool to create a 1-1 view stored as a separate feature layer.
